text: Program IntroductionThe graduates will be practical specialists who meet the social requirements, are provided with the theory and knowledge on modern administrative science, are skilled in modern information technology and English language, excel in the method of system science and system engineering, work on the construction and management and development of information resources in various fields.Main CoursesAdvanced language programming, object-oriented programming, web application development, principles and applications of databases, analysis and design of management information system, principles of management, accounting, financial management,principles of ERP system, ERP programming, ERP implementation and evaluation, English.Study Duration4 years.Degree AwardedWith necessary credits, those who have passed all the required courses and met the requirements for graduation of the university will be awarded bachelor's degree and diploma.Notes:*Program commences only if 15 students are enrolled ; otherwise you can study Chinese Language/ Pre- University Program/ other bachelor programs.*Although the courses are taught in English, all students are expected to meet HSK 4 (Chinese Language Test) as the minimal requirement for graduation.
